scenarios.scenario: Search and restore the recent-document list

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
the recent list contains a part named "Part26" and other documents
no other visible recent document matches "Part26"
no recent-document filters are active
the recent documents are displayed as a list
the user enters "Part26" in Search recent
the user activates the Search control
the recent list shows the matching part
the other previously visible documents are not displayed
the user clears the search field with its clear control
the search field is empty
the filtered result remains displayed
the user activates the Search control again
the other recent documents are displayed again

scenarios.scenario: Show recent search history after clearing a search

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
the user has searched recent documents for "Part26"
the user clears the search field with its clear control
a Search History panel appears beneath the field
it includes "Part26" preceded by a history symbol

scenarios.scenario: Switch between list and grid views of recent documents

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are displayed in List View
the user selects Grid View
recent documents appear as a grid of thumbnail cards
each visible card shows a document name and date
a Sort by control is displayed
the user selects List View
recent documents appear as rows with metadata columns

scenarios.scenario: Filter recent documents by assembly type and clears the filter

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent parts and assemblies are available
no recent-document filters are active
the user opens Filter and selects Assembly
the recent list displays assembly documents
the filter control indicates one active filter
the user chooses Clear filters
the Assembly filter is unchecked
recent parts and assemblies are displayed again
